title: Identity Profile Contract — Payload Schema (SUPERSEDED)
description: SUPERSEDED. This monolithic schema was replaced when identity.profile.v1 was migrated to meta-contract v2. Use: identity.profile.resolved.schema.json. Kept for historical reference only.

identity_id.description: Canonical, stable identifier owned by the identity subsystem. Not the same as buyer_id or cliente_id. Never reused.

email.description: Primary linkage key used to match a Buyer to a Cliente. Null for anonymous or guest identities. Pending ADR-006: whether email is the only valid linkage key.

buyer_id.description: Reference to the Buyer record in commerce.engine. Null if this identity was initiated from the ERP side.

cliente_id.description: Reference to the Cliente record in erp.core. Null if this identity was initiated from the Commerce side.

linkage_status.description: unlinked: identity exists in one system only, no verified match. linked: Buyer and Cliente have been verified as the same person. guest: no persistent identity record; session is ephemeral.

linked_at.description: Timestamp of when buyer_id and cliente_id were linked. Null if linkage_status is not 'linked'.
